description: Source code for a checkpoint server handling Hibernate and Wakeup processes via socket communication, including connection setup, message sending/receiving, and process control functions.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a socket connection (Unix or TCP) to the specified server locator with a timeout.

methods.name: SendRcvCmd
methods.description: Sends a command over the socket and receives a response, handling connection setup and timeout.

methods.name: HibernateProcess
methods.description: Initiates a hibernate (checkpoint) process for a given PID with a specified timeout.

methods.name: WakeupProcess
methods.description: Wakes up (restores) a process for a given PID with a specified timeout.
